//: Story Phase 12: inspect scripts in the galley, the hold and the cabin.
p12.inspect.dice: The Grand Dice of Grandness, display model, where it stopped: three. ONE DAY. A sticker under the pips.
Three months. For several beautiful seconds.
Every so often, inside it, something goes tik.
p12.inspect.six_dice: Six more Grand Dice, in their crate, in shredded paper, like eggs. Purple. Squeaky. Enough that none of them can mysteriously go missing.
Bob has drawn a face on one.
p12.inspect.regalia: The regalia, laid aside on the end of the bench for the Silence: the Grand Crown (fork, spoon, tiny saucepan), the painted cape, the saucepan-lid medal.
Garrick comes and looks at it now and then. He doesn't touch it. He's very careful not to touch it.
p12.inspect.salvage: The salvage crate: a boot, string, a bent sextant, a small anchor with no ship, and the empty space where the goggles were.
p12.inspect.wardrobe: Your wardrobe. The door is shut. Under it, a faint yellow curl comes out, slowly, and hangs in the air.
Inside are your good coat, your second-best coat, all your shirts, and the sash.
You don't open it. Your coats are on their own now.
